description_en: Retrieves the scan information of the latest virus scan
description_zh: 获取最新的病毒扫描的扫描信息
name: GetVirusScanLatestTaskStatistic

CompleteMachine.description_en: The number of servers that completed the scan

Progress.description_en: The progress percentage of the scan task
Progress.description_zh: 扫描任务进度的百分比

RiskLevel.description_en:
The highest risk level of the alerts detected by the scan. Valid values:

high: high-risk.
medium: medium-risk.
low: low-risk
RiskLevel.description_zh:
扫描出的告警的最高风险等级。取值：

high：高危。
medium：中危。
low：低危

SafeMachine.description_en: The number of servers on which no risks are detected
SafeMachine.description_zh: 未扫描出具有风险的机器数量

ScanMachine.description_en: The number of servers scanned in this virus scan
ScanMachine.description_zh: 此次病毒扫描机器的数量

ScanPath.description_en: The file paths specified for scanning when the scan type is user-defined
ScanPath.description_zh: 用户自定义类型时，指定的需要扫描的文件路径

ScanTime.description_en: The timestamp of the scan. Unit: milliseconds
ScanTime.description_zh: 扫描的时间戳，单位：毫秒

ScanType.description_en:
The scan type of this virus scan. Valid values:
system: automatic system scan.
user: user-defined scan
ScanType.description_zh:
此次病毒扫描的扫描类型。取值：
system：系统自动扫描。
user：用户自定义扫描

Status.description_en:
The status of the scan task.

Valid values for the main task:
0: The task is pending.
10: The scan is in progress.
100: The scan is complete.

Valid values for the subtask:
0: The scan is pending.
20: The detection script is delivered.
50: The scan is running on the server.
100: The scan is complete
Status.description_zh:
扫描任务的状态。

主任务取值：
0：任务待开始。
10：扫描进行中。
100：扫描完成。

子任务取值：
0：扫描待开始。
20：检测脚本下发。
50：扫描在机器上执行。
100：扫描结束

SuspiciousCount.description_en: The number of security alerts detected by the scan
SuspiciousCount.description_zh: 扫描出来的安全告警的数量

SuspiciousMachine.description_en: The number of servers on which risks are detected
SuspiciousMachine.description_zh: 扫描出来有风险的机器数量

TaskId.description_en: The ID of the scan task

UnCompleteMachine.description_en: The number of servers that have not completed the scan or failed the scan
UnCompleteMachine.description_zh: 未扫描结束和扫描失败的机器数量

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. Alibaba Cloud generates a unique identifier for each request. You can use the ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
